## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks before the Landau fan

Raw four-probe resistance and current are reconstructed with the recorded gains; the right panels use `sdh_fft` over 2–10 T. Run 6 is the D ≈ 0 electron point at n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻²; run 7 is the D ≈ 0 hole point at n = −1.2×10¹² cm⁻² (run 5 calibration). Both completed without clipping: sr1 was 50 µV full scale, and the largest signal was ≈ 0.6 kΩ at ≈ 10 nA, or ~6 µV. Gate-current offsets stayed far below the 1 nA trip.

**Read for the next measurement:** run 6 has clear field oscillations, with an ≈ 7.5 T tone and peaks near 15, 22.5, and 30 T that can be its harmonics. The full-density frequency from the run-5 calibration is ≈ 33 T, so assigning the 30 T peak to a separate pocket would be premature. Run 7 has a lower-frequency ≈ 5–6 T component and structure around 12–15 T, also unresolved by a single fixed-density trace. The hardwired B₁–B₂ pair averages two doping-offset CNP ridges separated by ≈ 0.43×10¹² cm⁻² (run 5); a density–field fan is needed to distinguish branches, harmonics, and this series-region offset. These runs alone support **no stacking verdict**.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_fft

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 7))
for row, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    rr = open_run(Path('data') / str(rid))
    cc = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(rr.meta)}
    bb = rr.col('magnet_field')
    ii = rr.col('sr0_X') / cc['sr0'].gain
    resistance = np.abs((rr.col('sr1_X') / cc['sr1'].gain) / ii)
    axes[row, 0].plot(bb, resistance, lw=0.9)
    axes[row, 0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)', title=f'data/{rid}: raw four-probe Rxx')
    ff, ss = sdh_fft(resistance[:, None], bb, b_range=(2.0, 10.0), nfft=2048, bg_degree=4)
    spectrum = ss[0]
    axes[row, 1].plot(ff, spectrum)
    axes[row, 1].set(xlim=(0, 65), xlabel='SdH frequency (T)', ylabel='FFT magnitude (arb.)',
                     title=f'data/{rid}: 2–10 T FFT')
    peaks, _ = find_peaks(spectrum)
    peaks = sorted((k for k in peaks if 2 <= ff[k] <= 65), key=lambda k: spectrum[k], reverse=True)[:5]
    print(f'data/{rid}: {len(bb)} points, B {bb[0]:.2f}→{bb[-1]:.2f} T; '
          f'|Rxx| {resistance.min():.1f}–{resistance.max():.1f} Ω; '
          f'I {ii.min()*1e9:.3f}–{ii.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; '
          f'T {rr.col("T_sample").min():.3f}–{rr.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K; '
          f'FFT peaks ' + ', '.join(f'{ff[k]:.1f} T' for k in peaks))
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

## HERA — Plan step 5: electron Landau fan (`landau-fan`)

> **05:23** · Landau fan B=0, then 1.5–10 T/0.1 T × nA=+0.35–+3.20e12/72 at D=0; TG 0.167–0.984 V, BG 0.110–1.166 V, Si=0, 200 µV, 2.2 s dwell · **ETA ~11:23** (≈6h)

Runs 6–7 show SdH oscillations but cannot separate a 7.5 T fundamental from its 15/22.5/30 T harmonics, or from the two density-offset regions seen in run 5. I will map the hardwired B₁–B₂ resistance versus field and the run-5 calibrated D_A=0 line: one B=0 baseline row, then 1.5–10 T by 0.1 T, each with n_A=+0.35–+3.20×10¹² cm⁻² in 72 steps. The corresponding TG (+0.167 to +0.984 V) and BG (+0.110 to +1.166 V) paths are inside the committed validators; Si stays at 0. This electron range includes the strong run-6 signal. The hole side and B=0.1–1.4 T are excluded to spend the long run on branch tracing where oscillations are already clear; the cost is no hole-fan symmetry or low-field filling sequence in this run. The absolute n scale remains tied to the TG thickness prior until the fan slopes check it.

Preflight reads actual field, both temperatures, Si, heater ranges, magnet switch/output, gate-current NPLC and lock-in timing; any mismatch stops before movement. The 2.2 s point dwell meets 7τ at the measured 0.3 s / 24 dB setting; sr1 is fixed at 200 µV (~20 kΩ at 10 nA) and a per-point guard interrupts on >1 nA gate current or near rail. The field ramp alone is 10/0.137 ≈ 73 min; 6,264 gate points at ≥2.2 s plus reads, row field settles and flyback price this at about 6 h using data/5–7 timing. **Checkpoints:** first two rows for live current, leakage, rail and a nonflat Rxx trace; then around 2, 5 and 8 T for resolved density-moving features and branch continuity. Stop on safety/rail or a washed-out fan. A kernel interrupt does not stop an already-commanded VTI magnet ramp; read actual field and ramp status before any recovery action. The sweep ends near 10 T and holds the last gates for a possible descending follow-up.

# Plan step 5 — electron Landau fan: B=0 baseline, then 1.5→10 T; calibrated D_A=0 density line.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Actual state and silent preconditions, before any write.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_t, _tv, _b = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_vsi, _si_range, _si_out = k_si(), dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output()
_hr1, _hr2 = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_nt, _nb = k_tg.nplci(), k_bg.nplci()
print(f'PRECONDITION: T_sample={_t:.3f} K [1.0,1.5], T_vaporizer={_tv:.3f} K [0.7,1.5]; '
      f'B={_b:+.4f} T [±0.05], Vsi={_vsi:+.4f} V [±0.01], Si range/output={_si_range}/{_si_out} [2/1]; '
      f'heater ranges={_hr1}/{_hr2} [0/0], PS/output={_ps}/{_out} [True/True], '
      f'TG/BG NPLC={_nt}/{_nb} [1/1]')
assert 1.0 <= _t <= 1.5 and 0.7 <= _tv <= 1.5 and abs(_b) < 0.05
assert abs(_vsi) < 0.01 and _si_range == 2 and _si_out == 1
assert _hr1 == 0 and _hr2 == 0 and _ps and _out
assert _nt == 1 and _nb == 1
assert not magnet.is_ramping(), 'magnet still ramping'
assert sr0.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.3
assert sr0.filter_slope() == 24 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24

# Run-5 calibration: measured Cbg/Ctg ratio and CNP/D offsets; absolute Ctg from 9.5 nm prior.
_ct, _cb, _n0, _d0 = 2.7960593093052633e-3, 2.160696465377614e-3, -0.08937933224099137, -0.013
_n = np.linspace(0.35, 3.20, 72)  # 1e12 cm^-2
_v_tg, _v_bg = calc_gate_voltages(_n, np.zeros_like(_n), _ct, _cb, n_offset=_n0, D_offset=_d0)
_n_check, _d_check = calc_nD(_v_tg, _v_bg, _ct, _cb, n_offset=_n0, D_offset=_d0)
_B = np.r_[0.0, np.round(np.arange(1.5, 10.0001, 0.1), 4)]
assert np.all(np.diff(_n) > 0) and np.all(np.diff(_B) > 0)
assert np.all((_v_tg >= TG_MIN) & (_v_tg <= TG_MAX)) and np.all((_v_bg >= BG_MIN) & (_v_bg <= BG_MAX))
assert abs(_d_check).max() < 1e-6 and abs(_n_check - _n).max() < 1e-6
assert _B[-1] <= B_SESSION_CAP and len(_B) == 87 and len(_n) == 72
print(f'GRID: {len(_B)} B rows ({_B[0]:.1f}, then {_B[1]:.1f}→{_B[-1]:.1f} T by 0.1) × {len(_n)} n points '
      f'({_n[0]:.2f}→{_n[-1]:.2f}e12, Δn={_n[1]-_n[0]:.4f}e12); '
      f'Vtg={_v_tg[0]:+.4f}→{_v_tg[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg={_v_bg[0]:+.4f}→{_v_bg[-1]:+.4f} V')

_drive = sr1.amplitude()
assert abs(_drive - 1.0) < 0.02, f'drive changed: {_drive} V'
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)  # 20 kΩ nominal R headroom at ~10 nA; fixed throughout the fan
assert sr1.sensitivity() == 200e-6 and sr0.sensitivity() >= 20e-3
print(f'BIAS/RANGES: {_drive:.3f} V / 100 MΩ = {_drive/100e6*1e9:.2f} nA; '
      f'sr1={sr1.sensitivity()*1e6:.0f} µV, sr0={sr0.sensitivity()*1e3:.1f} mV; '
      f'fast dwell 2.2 s ≥7τ at 24 dB/oct')

_mc = dict(meas_config)
_mc['Si (V)'] = _vsi
_mc['sample_temperature:'] = _t
_mc['comments'] = 'landau-fan: B 0 baseline, 1.5..10 T step 0.1; n_A +0.35..+3.20e12 step 0.0401, D_A=0; run-5 calibration; Vsi=0; sr1 200uV, dwell 2.2s'
s = sweep.AsyncStation(_mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('electron side B1-B2: B slow [0,1.5..10] T 87 rows; (TG,BG) fast co-swept 72 points for calibrated ridge-A n +0.35..+3.20e12 cm^-2 at D=0; run-5 c_bg/c_tg=0.773, n0=-0.089e12, D0=-0.013 V/nm; Si=0; 200uV sr1, 2.2s dwell')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(_v_bg[0]))
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(_v_tg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# Row layout: time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, sr0_X, sr1_X.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(sr0.X).fp(sr1.X)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr)
s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, i_x, v_x = (float(data[j]) for j in (5, 6, 7, 8))
    if abs(i_tg) > 1e-9 or abs(i_bg) > 1e-9 or abs(i_x) > 0.9*sr0.sensitivity() or abs(v_x) > 0.85*sr1.sensitivity():
        print(f'FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: '
              f'Itg={i_tg*1e12:+.0f} pA, Ibg={i_bg*1e12:+.0f} pA, '
              f'sr0X={i_x*1e3:+.2f} mV, sr1X={v_x*1e6:+.2f} µV')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

_result = s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [_B], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [_v_tg, _v_bg],
                           slow_delay=0.0, fast_delay=2.2)
print(f'FAN FINISHED: file_id={_result.id}; B readback={magnet.field():+.4f} T; '
      f'Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V; interrupted={_result.metadata.get("interrupted")}')

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)

s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
